platform: Tradovate demo (user selection); best bid/ask + depth snapshots; no message-level order flow
research_numbers: gross; execution assumptions are paper-only settings to be logged, never applied to findings

strategies.name: large_move_fade
blockers: adverse-path evidence after +5 s absent (stop is provisional)
strategies.session: Globex; no-trade in SETTLE_UTC guard window and first 15 min after 18:00 ET open (provisional)

extreme_wait_s.provenance: REVISED after robustness (M14): +1 s entry; +5 s misses 5/18/16/5 eventual returns

fill_rule.value: touch persists 1 s after order time else missed

rules.setup: Q0 = last midpoint before jump; trigger when |mid-Q0|>=2 ticks between consecutive quotes; d=sign
rules.entry: at the first quote after the trigger (+1 s) enter against d at the best quote on the joined side; record the running extreme
rules.exit: target Q0 touch or trigger+600 s
rules.stop: mid beyond E by 3 ticks in direction d
rules.priority: one position; opposite trigger while open -> suppressed+logged; same-direction trigger -> hold+log
rules.pause: no entries while open; cooldown 60 s; daily stop after 3 consecutive stops
rules.data_faults: stale>5 s: no entry, hold to target/time on next good quote; out-of-order: ignore+log; disconnect: cancel working, flatten at reconnect, log

strategies.adverse: 51 of 225 moves did not return within 600 s; Oct 18 returns slow (p50 84 s); prior-signal agreement does not sort returns
strategies.invalidation: prospective full-return share <0.6 over first 40 triggers or median return time >300 s

post_trade_exit_overlay.rule: exit if net native flow in the 20 s after the move continues with the jump
post_trade_exit_overlay.availability: message-level flow required; unavailable on Tradovate, log as such

strategies.name: dipole_recognition_log_no_entry
blockers: needs message-level flow to compute the 20 s native window; Tradovate lacks it
strategies.use: abstain from directional entry at recognition; exit warning when flow_state=opposite at recognition

strategies.name: thin_touch_retreat_nowcast
blockers: C9 sign convention unresolved for S3b

strategies.name: touch_imbalance_refill_nowcast
blockers: 1-2 tick move vs 1-2 tick spread; no fill evidence; needs depth/order counts

strategies.name: weakening_onset_exit_warning
blockers: no price-outcome evidence after onsets; message-level flow

strategies.name: dipole_weakening_no_reason_to_stay_exit

onset outcomes not measured conditional on an open position
strategies.evidence: CLAIMS X-4, X-6 (support); X-3, X-5 (negative results retained)
strategies.rule: log exits at first fresh_opposed_weakening or flow_vanished onset of the ridden dipole; evaluate oriented 5/20/60 s move per date
strategies.not_claimed: protective exit before an adverse move

strategies.name: dipole_drive_ride_lookahead_clock
blockers: message-level prints and classification required (Tradovate lacks it)
earliest-knowable population (qualifying peaks) not priced in packet

exit.value: first fresh opposed lot else 60 s

flip_overlay.value: reverse for 60 s when window majority-opposite

strategies.invalidation: prospective with:against ratio of non-flat rides below 1.5:1 over the first 100 qualifying peaks, or post-exhaustion 60 s moves not against the direction

entry_filters.quiet_window: total lots -20..+5 s below session median
entry_filters.thin_target: target touch size and order count lower tertile
